name: ta_trend_switch_indicators
script:
supertrend_fast, supertrend_fast_direction = ta.supertrend(1.5, 3)
supertrend_slow, supertrend_slow_direction = ta.supertrend(2.5, 4)
plus_di, minus_di, adx = ta.dmi(4, 3)
plot(ta.atr(4), "ATR 4")
plot(ta.sar(0.02, 0.02, 0.2), "SAR 0.02")
plot(ta.sar(0.04, 0.04, 0.2), "SAR 0.04")
plot(supertrend_fast, "Supertrend 1.5 3")
plot(supertrend_fast_direction, "Supertrend 1.5 3 Dir")
plot(supertrend_slow, "Supertrend 2.5 4")
plot(supertrend_slow_direction, "Supertrend 2.5 4 Dir")
plot(plus_di, "Plus DI 4")
plot(minus_di, "Minus DI 4")
plot(adx, "ADX 4 3")
pine_equivalent:
//@version=5
indicator("TA Trend Switch Indicators Golden")
[supertrend_fast, supertrend_fast_direction] = ta.supertrend(1.5, 3)
[supertrend_slow, supertrend_slow_direction] = ta.supertrend(2.5, 4)
[plus_di, minus_di, adx] = ta.dmi(4, 3)
plot(ta.atr(4), "ATR 4")
plot(ta.sar(0.02, 0.02, 0.2), "SAR 0.02")
plot(ta.sar(0.04, 0.04, 0.2), "SAR 0.04")
plot(supertrend_fast, "Supertrend 1.5 3")
plot(supertrend_fast_direction, "Supertrend 1.5 3 Dir")
plot(supertrend_slow, "Supertrend 2.5 4")
plot(supertrend_slow_direction, "Supertrend 2.5 4 Dir")
plot(plus_di, "Plus DI 4")
plot(minus_di, "Minus DI 4")
plot(adx, "ADX 4 3")

notes: TradingView export 2026-06-02, BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P 60m, trend switch TA capture
Promoted to parity after aligning ta.sar() with the TradingView reference helper and allowing 1e-8 float tail tolerance.
